newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Bula says Siberian well test successful.
newsitem.headline: Bula says Siberian well test successful.

text.p: Irish-based exploration firm Bula Resources Plc said on Monday that testing of its first development well at the Salymskoye Oilfield development in Western Siberia had been successful.
The company said in a statement that development well number 705 had been successfully tested over a four-day period at a rate of 150 cubic metres (942 barrels) per day on an eight mm choke.
"This well demonstrates the vast oil reserves contained in this oilfield and we hope to build up to first production before the year end," Bula Chairman Jim Stanley said.
"The pipeline link and pump station facilities have already been put in place which is a significant achievement for our company," he added.

Bula said Well 705 was the first development well to be drilled in the Salymskoye oilfield, which was estimated by independent engineering consultants to contain 585 million barrels of proven and probable recoverable oil reserves.
The company said drillling on the second development well was continuing.
